parameters.toolDescription: Get the bibliographic core for one US patent application from the USPTO Open Data Portal: title, filing and effective filing dates, applicant and inventor, current status, entity status, art unit, examiner, CPC classes, docket number, and patent/publication numbers with their dates. This is the default tool for "what is the status of application X". It deliberately omits the sub-collections — for those use USPTO Transactions (prosecution history), USPTO Continuity (family), USPTO Assignment (chain of title), USPTO Patent Term Adjustment, USPTO Attorney, or USPTO Documents (file wrapper).
parameters.url: =https://api.uspto.gov/api/v1/patent/applications/{{ $fromAI("applicationNumberText", "The US patent application number, e.g. 17/123,456 or 17123456", "string").replace(/[^0-9]/g, "") }}

parameters.toolDescription: Search US patent applications in the USPTO Open Data Portal and return a compact digest of matches. Use USPTO simplified query syntax over applicationMetaData.* fields, combined with AND / OR / NOT — for example applicationMetaData.inventionTitle:CRISPR AND applicationMetaData.applicationTypeLabelName:Utility, or applicationMetaData.firstApplicantName:"Genentech" AND applicationMetaData.filingDate:[2020-01-01 TO 2022-12-31]. Useful fields include inventionTitle, firstApplicantName, firstInventorName, filingDate, applicationStatusDescriptionText, applicationTypeLabelName, patentNumber, grantDate, groupArtUnitNumber and examinerNameText. The top-level "count" in the response is the TOTAL number of matching applications, not the number returned in this page. Use offset and limit to page through results. A zero-hit search returns count 0 rather than an error.

parameters.name: q
parameters.value: ={{ $fromAI("q", "USPTO simplified search query over applicationMetaData.* fields, e.g. applicationMetaData.inventionTitle:CRISPR AND applicationMetaData.applicationTypeLabelName:Utility", "string") }}

parameters.value: ={{ $fromAI("offset", "Zero-based result offset for paging, as a string", "string", "0") }}

parameters.name: limit
parameters.value: ={{ $fromAI("limit", "Maximum number of results to return in this page, as a string, max 100", "string", "25") }}

parameters.description: Download one document from a US patent application file wrapper and OCR it to markdown text. You MUST first call USPTO Documents to list the file wrapper and obtain the documentIdentifier for the filing you want; this tool cannot find a document by description. Use it to read Office Actions, applicant remarks and amendments, notices of allowance, IDS forms, claims and specifications. pageStart and pageEnd are optional and default to pages 1 through 30.
